integrated.name: Barker LOLA South Polar DTMs (USGS Astrogeology analysis-ready data)
integrated.provider: NASA LRO / LOLA team (Barker et al.); processed into analysis-ready COGs by the USGS Astrogeology Science Center
integrated.citation: Barker, M. K., et al. (2026). Lunar south polar digital terrain models from LOLA. https://doi.org/10.5066/P13YV93V (as given in the STAC item sci:citation field)
integrated.units: metres above the IAU 2015 lunar sphere (R = 1 737 400 m)
integrated.spatial_resolution: 5 m/pixel posting (effective resolution set by LOLA track density, coarser than the posting)
integrated.spatial_coverage: 27 sites near the lunar south pole, each ~16-30 km square; 8 used here
integrated.access_method: HTTP range reads of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs referenced by per-site STAC items
integrated.preprocessing: Reprojected into a 12 km x 12 km local azimuthal-equidistant window (same sphere) at 30 m with GDAL 'average' resampling (aggregation of ~6x6 source pixels).
integrated.limitations: Polar illumination and permanently shadowed regions do not affect height values but LOLA data density varies; 5 m posting overstates true resolution; only south-polar sites available in this product.

integrated.name: MRO CTX controlled DTMs (USGS Astrogeology analysis-ready data)
integrated.provider: NASA MRO Context Camera (MSSS/JPL); DTMs produced by the USGS Astrogeology Science Center with the Ames Stereo Pipeline
integrated.citation: USGS Astrogeology Science Center, MRO CTX controlled DTMs (STAC collection 'mro_ctx_controlled_usgs_dtms'); per-item STAC URLs are listed on each target.
integrated.units: metres; aligned to MOLA and adjusted to the Mars aeroid (per STAC description)
integrated.temporal_coverage: Product creation 2023 (STAC datetime); source images span the MRO mission
integrated.access_method: HTTP range reads of Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs referenced by per-pair STAC items
integrated.preprocessing: Reprojected into a 12 km x 12 km local azimuthal-equidistant window at 30 m with GDAL 'average' resampling.
integrated.limitations: Automated stereo DTMs contain matching noise and occasional artefacts; footprints are narrow strips so a 12 km window may need to be shifted to find full coverage (recorded per target).

integrated.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (ESA / Copernicus), AWS Open Data COGs
integrated.provider: European Space Agency / Copernicus Programme (DLR & Airbus Defence and Space, TanDEM-X mission); COG conversion and hosting on the AWS Registry of Open Data
integrated.citation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED). (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved.
integrated.units: metres (EGM2008 geoid heights per the Copernicus DEM product handbook; not verifiable from the build environment)
integrated.spatial_resolution: 1 arc-second (~30 m) in latitude; longitude spacing widens above 50 degrees latitude
integrated.spatial_coverage: Global land, except tiles not released publicly; ocean areas have no tiles
integrated.license: Copernicus DEM licence: free use with attribution (see the provider's licence text)
integrated.access_method: HTTP range reads of 1x1 degree Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF tiles; tile existence checked against the bucket's tileList.txt (cached in data/sources)
integrated.preprocessing: Each 12 km window is warped from all overlapping tiles into a local azimuthal-equidistant grid (WGS84 ellipsoid) at 30 m with bilinear resampling. Missing tiles stay missing; we do NOT assume zero height over ocean.
integrated.limitations: Digital SURFACE model: vegetation, buildings and ice surfaces are included. Water bodies are flattened. Not a NASA product (NASA NASADEM/SRTM require Earthdata Login, which was unreachable from the build environment).

integrated.name: ECOSTRESS land-surface temperature (ECO_L2T_LSTE v002)
integrated.provider: NASA JPL / ECOSTRESS on the ISS; distributed by the NASA LP DAAC
integrated.citation: ECOSTRESS Science Team, ECOSTRESS Tiled Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity Instantaneous L2 Global 70 m V002, NASA LP DAAC. Granule ids used are recorded per location.
integrated.spatial_resolution: 70 m on the Sentinel-2 MGRS grid
integrated.spatial_coverage: about 52 S to 52 N (ISS orbit), in swaths
integrated.temporal_coverage: v002 archive; the scenes used are listed per location
integrated.license: Open NASA data; LP DAAC data-use guidance; attribution requested
integrated.authentication: NASA Earthdata Login (bearer token); the distribution endpoint redirects to a signed CloudFront URL
integrated.access_method: CMR granule search, then GDAL HTTP range reads of the Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF assets
integrated.preprocessing: Scenes restricted to local solar 11:00-16:00 (day) and 22:00-05:00 (night); cloud and water flags and temperatures outside 200-360 K masked; a scene must cover >= 40% of the window; 3-4 scenes per side reduced to a per-pixel median; the day-night pair must cover >= 60% of the window.
integrated.limitations: Skin temperature under an atmosphere, so not comparable with lunar or Martian surface temperature; only the derived apparent thermal inertia is used, as a within-body rank. Overpass local time drifts; cloud screening is imperfect; no coverage above about 52 degrees latitude.

integrated.name: VIIRS/NPP BRDF white-sky shortwave albedo (VNP43MA3 v002)
integrated.provider: NASA/NOAA Suomi-NPP VIIRS; NASA LP DAAC
integrated.citation: VIIRS/NPP BRDF/Albedo Albedo Daily L3 Global 1 km SIN Grid V002, NASA LP DAAC. Granule ids used are recorded per location.
integrated.license: Open NASA data; LP DAAC data-use guidance
integrated.access_method: CMR granule search, HDF5 download, band cached per tile, granule deleted
integrated.preprocessing: Only cells with mandatory quality flag 0 (full BRDF inversion) kept; warped to the 12 km window grid; median of the two dates.
integrated.limitations: 1 km cells are far coarser than the 30 m window grid; two dates do not capture the seasonal cycle; snow cover on those dates biases polar windows.

integrated.name: EMIT estimated mineral identification and band depth (EMITL2BMIN v002)
integrated.provider: NASA JPL EMIT on the ISS; NASA LP DAAC
integrated.citation: EMIT L2B Estimated Mineral Identification and Band Depth 60 m V002, NASA JPL/LP DAAC. Granule ids used are recorded per location.
integrated.units: mineral id (index into the product spectral library); band depth unitless
integrated.spatial_coverage: arid dust-source regions, about 52 S to 52 N, in swaths
integrated.crs: EPSG:4326 (geotransform in the granule root attributes)
integrated.license: Open NASA data; LP DAAC data-use guidance
integrated.access_method: CMR granule search, netCDF/HDF5 download, orthorectification through the product's own GLT, then deletion
integrated.preprocessing: Up to 3 granules merged (newest first, each filling only uncovered cells); a window needs >= 50% swath coverage; spectral-library names grouped into mineral classes by documented substring rules (served at /api/environment); pixels with no identification counted as a measured 'no diagnostic absorption'.
integrated.limitations: Per-pixel spectral-library matches of surface spectra, not bulk composition. The class grouping is this project's, not EMIT's. No equivalent archived planetary mineral product was reachable, so these values are displayed and never scored.

integrated.name: MGS TES derived nightside thermal inertia map
integrated.provider: NASA MGS Thermal Emission Spectrometer; maps derived by N. E. Putzig and M. T. Mellon; PDS Geosciences Node
integrated.citation: Putzig, N. E. and Mellon, M. T., MGS TES Derived Thermal Inertia Maps, MGS-M-TES-5-TIMAP-V1.0, NASA Planetary Data System (see Putzig & Mellon 2007; Putzig et al. 2005, listed in the archive's REF.CAT).
integrated.units: J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2 (tiu); derived range 5-5000
integrated.spatial_coverage: global; infilled between 87 S and 87 N (archive states < 8% infilled)
integrated.crs: simple cylindrical on a 3396.0 km sphere, planetocentric, east positive
integrated.access_method: direct HTTP download of the PDS3 image, read as a raw MSB int16 array per its detached label
integrated.preprocessing: Values outside 5-5000 tiu dropped; warped to the 12 km Mars window; window median reported with the interpolated-area fraction from the archive's mask.
integrated.limitations: A 12 km window holds only about 16 source pixels, so values are regional. Model-derived, nightside only. The label's sphere radius (3396.0 km) differs from the CTX DTM sphere by about 190 m, which is irrelevant at 3 km sampling.

integrated.name: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product, south (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0)
integrated.provider: NASA LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment team (D. A. Paige, UCLA); PDS Geosciences Node
integrated.citation: Paige, D. A. et al., LRO Diviner Derived Polar Resource Products, LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0, in bundle urn-nasa-pds-lro_diviner_derived1, NASA Planetary Data System.
variables: temp_avg (annual average temperature at 2 cm depth)
integrated.spatial_resolution: triangular mesh of about 240 m facets (2 880 000 facets)
integrated.crs: planetocentric lat/lon on a 1737.4 km sphere
integrated.access_method: direct HTTP download of the 605 MB ASCII table, parsed once and cached
integrated.preprocessing: Facets whose centre falls inside the 12 km window (in the window's own projection) are selected, not resampled; a window needs >= 50 facets; medians reported.
integrated.limitations: Modelled temperatures constrained by Diviner, not direct measurements, and illumination-driven: not thermal inertia and not comparable with the Earth or Mars thermal values, so displayed only. ice_depth = -999 means deeper than 2.8738 m per the label; the value -1 (3.5% of rows) is undocumented there, so both are treated as not reported.

investigated_not_integrated.name: NASA Earthdata Search / CMR
investigated_not_integrated.status: CMR granule search is now used by the thermal and mineral build; the web UI is not.
investigated_not_integrated.would_provide: Granule discovery for ECOSTRESS, VIIRS albedo and EMIT (now integrated)

investigated_not_integrated.name: NASA AppEEARS
investigated_not_integrated.status: Not used: granules are read directly from the LP DAAC distribution endpoint. Its supported product list was not verified.
investigated_not_integrated.would_provide: Task-based point/area extraction of the same products

investigated_not_integrated.name: MODIS MCD43A3 albedo
investigated_not_integrated.status: Not integrated: granules are HDF-EOS2 (HDF4) and this GDAL build has no HDF4 driver. VNP43MA3 (HDF5) is used instead.

investigated_not_integrated.name: Mars mineral maps (MRO CRISM, MGS TES mineral abundance)
investigated_not_integrated.status: Searched, not integrated. The reachable CRISM collections are targeted/multispectral radiance and summary products needing per-scene spectral processing, not a global mineral-class map, and pds.nasa.gov, ode.rsl.wustl.edu, astrogeology.usgs.gov and planetarymaps.usgs.gov are refused by this environment's egress policy. Without a counterpart, EMIT mineral classes stay Earth-side context.

investigated_not_integrated.name: Lunar thermal inertia
investigated_not_integrated.status: Searched, not available. The reachable Diviner collections hold brightness temperatures, rock abundance (80 S to 80 N, so not the polar targets) and the modelled polar products that are integrated; no thermal inertia product. The thermal feature is reported missing for every Moon target with that reason.
investigated_not_integrated.would_provide: A Moon side for the thermal-inertia comparison

investigated_not_integrated.name: THEMIS Mars infrared mosaics (USGS archive)
investigated_not_integrated.status: Not used: the available mosaics are 8-bit rendered images, not calibrated temperatures.

investigated_not_integrated.name: NASA Moon Trek / Mars Trek
investigated_not_integrated.status: Not reachable. Visualization portals; no supported public scientific API was verified, so they are not used as a data source.

investigated_not_integrated.name: PDS Geosciences elevation products (LOLA LDEM, MOLA MEGDR)
investigated_not_integrated.status: Reachable, but not needed for elevation: the same LOLA team products are used through the USGS analysis-ready archive. This host provides the TES and Diviner products that are integrated.
investigated_not_integrated.would_provide: Global lunar and Martian DEMs at coarser resolution
